## Lesson body

Don’t tokenize the payable. Assign or package the cash-producing asset that retires it.

That sentence is the product. Cipher Coast Academy teaches studio-scale liability defeasance: name the bill, name the titled cash that kills the bill, route that cash through a Safe sink with a human on the signature. The institutional vendor-finance loop you see in chip capex is context. It is not our traction, not a public note, and not a reason to wrap a studio invoice as a token.

Login tokens are credentials. They are not equity, not yield, not Book A.

Public advertised tuition: **M0 $49. Full academy $599. Agent bypass $899.** À la carte modules M1–M4 sit on the price card. Studio 5-seat is $2,400 / 12 months. There is no cheap prompt-book-only SKU.
